heading: Supplemental authority of the Secretary
lead: The authority of the Secretary under this subchapter to assist councils in the development and implementation of area plans shall be supplemental to, and not in lieu of, any authority of the Secretary under any other provision of law.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 3459, Pub. L. 97–98, title XV, § 1536, Dec. 22, 1981, 95 Stat. 1340; Pub. L. 101–624, title XIV, § 1452(a), Nov. 28, 1990, 104 Stat. 3611, related to limitation on assistance, prior to the general amendment of this subchapter by Pub. L. 107–171.

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 97–98, title XV, § 1536, as added Pub. L. 107–171, title II, § 2504, May 13, 2002, 116 Stat. 274.)
